findings.reason: {computer} is inserted uninflected (refusal.ts copyFor → t(key,{computer: subject}); subject = the reader-chosen computer name, else a fallback noun or an address — connection-provider.tsx:2583-2590). These 9 headlines place it after a preposition that governs an oblique case (к + dative ×4, на + prepositional ×5), so any declinable name the reader gives (e.g. «Домашний ноутбук») renders ungrammatically: «Local Operator не запущен на Домашний ноутбук.», «доступ с телефона к Домашний ноутбук». The translated fallback 'Ваш компьютер' accepted in a later slice (m3-s2b2b record) makes it systematic: «…на Ваш компьютер.». The same file already ships the case-neutral pattern for offline.title («{computer}: …»); use it for all nine so {computer} stays nominative. Alternative only if code drops the noun fallback: appositive «на компьютере «{computer}»». Also folds a calque: refused.title «сейчас не разрешил» (perfective past + 'now') → «пока не разрешает».

findings.reason: Replaces the 'Copy diagnostics' button label for ~2 s (settings.tsx:687-694; Button has no labelLines, so it wraps). 43 chars vs en 25 (1.72×) and vs the 22-char resting label: on a 320 pt phone the outline button likely grows to two lines, then shrinks — a visible layout jump. A ~26-char label keeps one line and still says what to do.
Same en ('Try again in a moment.') as radient_unreachable.body, which ships «Попробуйте ещё раз чуть позже.»; «через минуту» is more specific than 'in a moment'. Use one rendering.
Grammatically safe (nominative) but telegraphic; a verb phrase with {computer} as subject is equally case-safe for a name, the fallback noun or an address and reads as a sentence like its siblings.

Executed with the repo parser: ru relay_stopped.title renders «Local Operator не запущен на Your computer.». Every locale shows English there. A prior ru record (m3-s2b2b) indicates a translated your_computer key is in flight; once wired, ru-GAP-1 must be fixed in the same change or the headlines read «…на Ваш компьютер».
